text: Truly awesome app. It takes your dictated gibberish and turns it into readable, reliable language. I can't recommend it highly enough once you get used to using it, and I strongly recommend that you try using it at all times whenever possible. Even when you need to switch to the written, typed word, you just do it with a swipe to the right and the keyboard is there for you to use to enter numbers or whatever. Then you just swipe to the left, and there you go dictating again.
